name: Southern Cross Student Opportunities Fund
summary: Up to $7,500 towards travel, accommodation and activities for an almost-confirmed career or skills opportunity, for SCU undergraduates past first year.
who: Current undergraduate students in second year or later.
First-year students and past recipients can't apply.
how: Apply through the online form with a proposal, timeline, correspondence and a detailed budget.
catches: Job interviews and international travel are generally not funded.
The project must finish at least two months before you graduate.
